notes.title: We Temporarily Rollback Incubo to Previous Version
notes.notes:
In the last update (1.1) we got some feedback about the cutscene that was not called, we checked it and we found the problem.

We use unity as our game engine and just realized that in the last unity update there were some changes that cause bugs, so we returned Incubo to the previous version until we completed the Incubo adjustment to the latest unity version.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Best Regards,
Hehe Gamez

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Lately we have received input from players that the controller uses the keyboard is hard to play. In update 1.1, we tried modifying the controller by adding an alternate button on keyboard. And fixed some minor bugs.

Once again we are very grateful for the reports from the players about Incubo.

Best Regards,
Hehe Gamez

notes.title: Update 1.094
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for the feedback. We have made several updates. This update (build 1.094) fixes various issues and adjusting stage difficulty. Here are the changes and the improvements that are made:

Changes:
-. Reduced difficulty on Yurei stage
-. Reduced difficulty on clown boss stage
-. Adjusted ropes position on clown boss stage

Bug fixes:
-. Fixed bugs that make player dead when skip cutscene at "line up properly" stage

Thank you for your support ! 

Best Regards,
Hehe Gamez
